title: Ring of point lights
prompt: Place 8 point lights evenly in a ring of radius 600 around the actor 'Stage', 300 units above it. Every light's intensity must be 8000.

scene.expr: all(abs(dist(a, find('Stage').get_actor_location() + vec([0, 0, 300])) - 600) < 5 for a in [a for a in actors if isinstance(a, unreal.PointLight)])
scene.name: radius 600 at +300

scene.expr: min(dist(a, b) for a in [a for a in actors if isinstance(a, unreal.PointLight)] for b in [a for a in actors if isinstance(a, unreal.PointLight)] if a is not b) > 440
scene.name: evenly spaced

scene.expr: all(abs(a.get_editor_property('light_component').get_editor_property('intensity') - 8000) < 1 for a in [a for a in actors if isinstance(a, unreal.PointLight)])
scene.name: intensity 8000
